_comment: Hand-maintained facts for the video. Change them here, then run scripts/build_data.py. Sources in brackets.

dataset.name: main-clean2
dataset._source: Fallback only: scripts/coverage.py counts the sort model's real dataset and build_data.py uses that. main-clean2 = SmolVLA-v2 and v2-long (MODEL_RUN_NOTES.md)

models._source: loop/cell_config.json during the filmed take. Default: latest:smolvla = SmolVLA-v2-long on the GPU for both stages (14:43, smoother than v2 offline). Rerun scripts/coverage.py after changing

sentences.GOOD: The brick is good. Put it on the green plate.
sentences.DEFECTIVE: The brick is defective. Put it on the orange plate.

evaluation._source: Filled automatically from video/layouts/round_*_eval.json (tools/eval_round.py). Set numbers here only to override them by hand.

run_take._source: the filmed round: its loop/runs folder, its layout file (video/layouts/round_NN.json), and the footage time where the log's first cycle starts. plate_swap_shown: set false if the mid-run plate swap failed in testing; the run scene then drops that part (VIDEO_PLAN 13.5)
